relationships.subject: onabotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: Next, botulinum toxin uses its endopeptidase light chain to deactivate the synaptosomal protein known as SNAP-25.

relationships.subject: onabotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: The ability of ONA-BoNTA to block CGRP is likely critical to its therapeutic role in migraines.

relationships.subject: onabotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: The main results from the PREEMPT clinical program have established that ONA-BoNTA is a safe, well-tolerated and effective headache prophylactic treatment for CM

key_findings: Botulinum toxin cleaves SNAP-25, blocking release of CGRP, substance P and glutamate; effective prophylaxis for chronic migraine (PREEMPT).
